text: Thirteen of the twenty two banks we track lent more than they raised this year. A U Small Finance Bank did the opposite.
Clue one. Loans grew thirty three thousand crore. Deposits grew thirty eight thousand crore.
Clue two. Cheap CASA grew twenty nine percent, as fast as total deposits. So the CASA ratio held, at twenty nine and a half.
The twist. The headline loan growth, twenty eight percent, is helped by selling fewer loans. The full portfolio grew twenty five.
Still, that's a deposit engine keeping pace. Back to the napkin.
